newsitem.title: MEXICO: At least one dead, 26 injured in Mexico collision.
newsitem.headline: At least one dead, 26 injured in Mexico collision.

text.p: A train collided with a truck carrying butane gas on Thursday in the central Mexican state of Guanajuato, causing an explosion that killed at least one person and injured up to 26 more, the state government said.
Unconfirmed media reports said up to four people may have been killed in the accident.
The accident took place in Comonfort, about 37 miles (60 km) from the state capital, Leon.
